Subject: Bulk vendor CSV import failing — 'source_id' mismatch

Hi Jonas,

We're trying to do our first bulk vendor import into your portal (Ariba connector) and the job keeps failing with a 'source_id mismatch' error. The import UI shows 1,200 rows processed and then the job ends in ERROR without giving a clear row-level failure. Attached is a redacted sample CSV (greenorchid_vendors_sample.csv) and a screenshot of the errored import screen.

We validated that vendor IDs in our system match the 'vendor_id' column we exported, but the portal appears to be expecting something called 'source_id' in each row. Can you point us to the expected CSV schema? We're blocked on converting the entire feed.

Also: one of our onboarding admins couldn't complete MFA when they tried to accept the portal invite — the accept flow fell back to SMS but the SMS OTP never arrived. We filed an internal ticket (procurement_it) but wanted to loop you in.

Thanks,
Elena Morales

Subject: Re: Bulk vendor CSV import failing — 'source_id' mismatch

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick note and for attaching the sample.

Short answers up front:
- The portal import expects a column named 'source_id' when the tenant is configured to accept synchronized vendor IDs from an upstream ERP. If you exported 'vendor_id' from Green Orchid's system, our importer will try to match against an existing mapping and fail when the tenant is set to 'authored_by_erp'.
- I pushed a short checklist below to get you unblocked.

Checklist (quick):
1) Can you confirm whether the CSV column header is 'vendor_id' or 'vendorId'? (case matters in our import step)
2) If Green Orchid wants to treat your file as a fresh vendor list (not ERP sync), rename the column to 'source_id' and re-run the import.
3) We've attached a one-page workaround that our onboarding team uses for customers who can't modify their export upstream. It does a lightweight rewrite of headers during upload.

On the MFA/SMS issue: we're seeing intermittent carrier delivery delays for short-code SMS in your region. Ben (cc'd) is the best person to scope a fallback: we can generate a temporary email-based OTP and a pre-seeded passkey enrollment link so your admins can accept the invite without SMS.

I'm looping Ben and Lauren to coordinate the header rename + temporary acceptance flow.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Customer Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Forwarding for ops action — I tried to reproduce locally with a sanitized copy of Elena's CSV and hit the same failure. Notes below and next steps.

Repro notes:
- Import pipeline validated: our schema checker ran and flagged header 'vendor_id' (lowercase underscore) as unmapped; the tenant was on 'erp_sync' mode so the importer required 'source_id'.
- The importer log (snippet) shows: "ERROR importer: header_mismatch: required 'source_id' not found; aborting" — no row-level exceptions, it's a header validation failure.

Temporary workaround I applied for Green Orchid (attached 'workaround-checklist.pdf'): we used the UI upload rewrite that maps 'vendor_id' -> 'source_id' during ingest and requeued the job. That succeeded for a small 200-row sample. I recommend doing the full run overnight.

MFA fallback: I provisioned a one-time email OTP flow and sent an enrollment link to Elena's procurement admin; that should allow invite acceptance even if carrier SMS fails. We should still triage carrier delivery separately.

Action items:
- Lauren: can you send the tenant toggle steps to Elena's procurement_it so they can choose 'treat-as-fresh-import' if they prefer editing upstream?
- Jonas: confirm once you get full-run success so I can mark GH-47211 as "resolved (workaround)".

—Ben

Hi Elena — glad Ben's workaround worked for the 200-row sample.

I've attached a short tenant-runbook and the exact UI steps to flip the import mode if you want future uploads to accept 'vendor_id' without renaming. Steps are straightforward and low-risk: toggle 'Import mode' -> select 'Accept vendor_id as source' -> Save -> Re-run import.

If you prefer, we can run the full 1,200-row import tonight at 10PM PT using our rewrite, and we'll monitor the job and share a per-row report. Please reply with a go/no-go and the best contact for the monitoring window.

Also: I confirmed the email-OTP enrollment link was used by one of your admins at 08:49 this morning — they accepted the invite and the account shows "active". We recommend leaving SMS as a backup but using passkey/email-OTP for the short term while carriers investigate.
